lifetime_and_invalidation.binding: Exact live CPU bank identity, source tensor identity/pointer/version/shape/stride/dtype, byte-backed immutable original layout tuples, explicit provenance, and original CUDA stream.
lifetime_and_invalidation.device_inputs: Cached tensors must stay non-grad and their identity/pointer/version/shape/dtype stamps match on reuse.
lifetime_and_invalidation.error: No shortened parent, dtype fallback, alternate block size, retry launcher or partial-gradient success. Failures propagate; explicit abort invalidates later graph reuse.
lifetime_and_invalidation.lease: Original custom-trunk autograd node post-hook marks successful complete backward. close before that fails. Any failed candidate call must abort_hot_pack before releasing the executor.
lifetime_and_invalidation.release: Clears all strong device entries and held CPU layout references. Existing layout lease releases only afterward. Actual CUDA allocation/free state must be reread; dropping references is not proof of physical release.
lifetime_and_invalidation.source_mutation: Torch in-place changes and tensor replacement are rejected. Raw-storage/NumPy writes bypassing Torch version tracking remain forbidden by the existing immutable-bank contract; this candidate does not claim to detect such unsupported external writes.
lifetime_and_invalidation.thread_handling: RLock serializes cache state; CUDA autograd engine thread continuation is allowed. v1 thread-affinity guard was superseded before anyGPU test.

resource_closure.CPU_metadata: Finite per-block namespaces/tensor stamps and source/immutable-layout stamps; host caller retains original preparation/training headroom.
resource_closure.admission: Before first allocation and each cold block: actual CUDA reserved+remaining entire pack+16GiB complete scratch <= explicit soft cap; physical free >= remaining pack+16GiB. Caller existing resource check also runs. No allocator empty_cache or silent fallback.
resource_closure.extra_host_working_storage: Existing layout arrays reused. Relative sample indices allocate one block-local CPU tensor (at most6,553,600bytes for512x1600 int64) and PyTorch conversion/staging uses original transfer path. No full host clone or pinned-memory pool is introduced.
resource_closure.largest_new_pack_fraction: All blocks remain resident; original measured single-block activation, context-copy, decoder and backward workspace must still fit. The nominal addition double counts some original current-block inputs but cannot bound allocator fragmentation or a different peak.
